articles.title: Coinsbuy offers $100K reward after Sunday security breach
articles.description: Coinsbuy said it covered all affected client funds after unauthorized withdrawals, while an onchain investigator estimated more than $7.9 million was stolen.

articles.title: Aptoide becomes the first rival app store to return to Google Play in the US
articles.description: Aptoide has brought its games store back to Google Play after more than a decade, as court-ordered changes open Android to competing app stores.

articles.title: Social media platforms still facing thousands of user addiction lawsuits after failed appeals
articles.description: Platforms like Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, and Google are facing a long road of litigation.

articles.title: ‘Disappointing’ — crypto advocates react to delay in CLARITY vote
articles.description: Following a procedural delay in the US Senate, lawmakers are expected to address a major crypto market structure bill after they return from a month-long recess, which met with industry criticism.

articles.title: Meta’s new Glimmer AI model offers a hint at Zuckerberg’s personal intelligence vision
articles.description: Meta’s new open-weight Muse Glimmer model offers a glimpse of Mark Zuckerberg’s personal superintelligence vision, as well as  the emerging divide between AI users can own and access.

articles.title: Bitcoin price slip wipes weekend gains as oil surge hits 5% on Hormuz disappointment
articles.description: Bitcoin wobbled with US stocks as Iran deflated hopes on the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz oil route, while analysis praised “exceptionally strong” institutional BTC inflows.

articles.title: BlackRock launches two Canada ETFs, with one allocating 3% to Bitcoin
articles.description: BlackRock Canada’s new IBQT fund combines global equity exposure with a 3% Bitcoin allocation through the firm’s Canadian iShares Bitcoin ETF.

articles.title: Sila lands $1.4B Pentagon loan as militaries demand more batteries
articles.description: Battery materials startup Sila will use a $1.4 billion loan from the U.S. Department of Defense to scale production at its factory in Washington state.

articles.title: Grayscale quietly drops Cardano, Polkadot and Hedera ETF plans
articles.description: The asset manager said it no longer intends to proceed with the offerings. None became effective, and no securities were issued or sold.

articles.title: Solana lending giant Jupiter now lets the same dollar earn twice
articles.description: The new Lend v2 product turns deposits and borrowed assets into trading liquidity, tying higher returns to whether Jupiter’s router can send enough swap flow to the new vaults.

articles.title: A data breach at shipping giant Ceva Logistics is rippling across banks, retailers, Steam gamers, and beyond
articles.description: Companies that rely on Ceva Logistics for shipping their physical goods to customers say their personal data was taken during a recent cyberattack.

articles.title: Bitmine’s ETH buying slows as Tom Lee's firm shifts capital to share buybacks
articles.description: Chairman Tom Lee said easing financial conditions could support crypto, even as the CLARITY Act failed to reach a Senate vote before the August recess.

articles.title: Solana gets its first Strategy STRC product through Solstice Finance
articles.description: The Solana vault splits income from Strategy’s preferred stock into a lower-risk senior token and a higher-risk junior token.

articles.title: Bitdeer increased Bitcoin mining output by nearly fivefold in Q2
articles.description: Bitdeer mined 2,694 BTC in Q2, but ended the quarter holding just 150 BTC after liquidating its treasury earlier this year.
